deformation.description: Each regional curve drives a separate spatially weighted shape key on the unified skin mesh. The curve is sampled at every output frame; regions have independent onset, acceleration and plateau.
deformation.wardrobe_response: The same regional shape-key controls are applied to the fitted garment meshes. This is a geometric prototype, not cloth simulation.
deformation.environment_response: Not yet simulated; architecture remains a scale reference.

evidence.notes: These curves are explicit authored timing controls for this fictional project. They are not measurements extracted from a Hulum's Cave source video.
